title: Optimize RETURNING result preallocation
constraints: Preserve INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE RETURNING result semantics
rationale: The DML RETURNING result builder knows the RETURNING item count and affected row count before materializing the result. Preallocating column names, result rows, and per-row projection vectors reduces allocation growth during RETURNING-heavy write workloads.
steps: Preallocate RETURNING column names from RETURNING item count
Preallocate returned rows from affected row count
Preallocate each projected RETURNING row from RETURNING item count
Verify INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE RETURNING behavior
expected_impact: Reduces allocation churn in DML RETURNING result construction without changing returned columns or values.
